title: vLLM shared cache keys allow cross-request state aliasing
organization: Patch the Planet (OpenAI and Trail of Bits)
summary: Caller-controlled EXIF image identifiers and untyped prefix-cache extra keys can produce collisions between requests. The project advisory groups these two cache-identity sites together; the reported result is cross-request cached-state confusion, not demonstrated code execution.
ai_role: The vLLM project advisory attributes the discovery to GPT-5.5-Cyber through Patch the Planet. The advisory identifies the reporting collaboration; it does not establish exclusive autonomy or an exact private discovery date.
classification_note: The public advisory describes the finding; no prior exploitation or previously unknown status is established.
remediation_note: The advisory lists versions below 0.31.0 as affected and 0.31.0 as patched. The linked PR #51899 tags prefix-cache domains but states that the attempted EXIF hasher change was dropped; complete remediation of both sites is not established by that patch alone.

impacts.conditions: A caller controls an image EXIF identifier or, for the prefix-cache case, an enabled cache salt and a known static LoRA name. The advisory describes cache state confusion and substitution, with site-specific preconditions.
impacts.exploitation: The cited advisory does not report observed exploitation.
